Convert an archive to/from a "vstretched, numeric" form

Source: R/vstretched_numeric_formats.R
to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info.Rd

Arithmetic is slow on some time-related classes. It can be faster to perform operations under integer time_type. These functions provide conversions to/from integer-time-type epi_archives which preserve time-time spacing in terms of nsteps and the ordering of versions, but which do not try to preserve anything about time-version differences or version-version differences; thus "vstretched".

Usage

to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info(x)

from_vstretched_numeric_archive_info(transformed_x, conversion)

Arguments

x

an epi_archive

transformed_x

an epi_archive with time_type "integer" and bare numeric time_values and versions, in the converted form described by conversion; e.g., to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info(x)$archive or some processed version of it. time_values must be integerish.

conversion

the conversion element of the to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info output.

Value

  • Of to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info: a list with elements:

    • archive: the converted epi_archive, with time_type "integer".

    • conversion: a list with elements time_type (x$time_type), torigin, and vorigin, to pass to from_vstretched_numeric_archive_info or use when converting other time values and versions.

  • Of from_vstretched_numeric_archive_info: transformed_x with time_type, time_value, and version representations converted back to those of the original archive.

Details

to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info converts an archive x to (i) an archive with integer time_type and bare numeric time_values and versions, plus (ii) conversion metadata, with (i) and (ii) packed in a named list. from_vstretched_numeric_archive_info converts from this format back to the format of x.

For some verbs, we may need to transform additional arguments using time_values_to_torigin_offsets, versions_to_vorigin_offsets, or version_bound_to_vorigin_offset_bound, forwarding the appropriate extra arguments from the info object's conversion metadata.

Verbs that change the number of archive rows from zero to nonzero are incompatible with the "from" transformation.
